title: Continuous-Time Policy Gradient from Discrete Data: Convergence Analysis and Model-Free Algorithms
abstract: arXiv:2610.28580v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Continuous-time reinforcement learning seeks an optimal policy under unknown dynamics driven by stochastic differential equations using observations collected at discrete times. We develop a policy gradient framework that combines rigorous convergence analysis with learning from discrete data. We first establish a performance difference lemma and derive policy gradient formulas for randomized and parametrized policies. We then prove exponential convergence of an entropy-regularized policy flow to the regularized optimum. For discrete parametrized updates, we derive a convergence bound that explicitly separates the contributions of critic error, policy-regression error, and the learning step size. To enable learning under unknown dynamics, we integrate this framework with PhiBE, which constructs a continuous-time surrogate generator from discrete transition data. translated_title: 基于离散数据的连续时间策略梯度：收敛分析与无模型算法
translated_abstract: 连续时间强化学习旨在由随机微分方程驱动的未知动力学下，利用离散时刻采集的观测数据寻求最优策略。我们开发了一个策略梯度框架，将严格的收敛分析与从离散数据中学习相结合。我们首先建立了性能差分引理，并推导出随机化策略和参数化策略的策略梯度公式。随后，我们证明了熵正则化策略流到正则化最优解的指数收敛性。对于离散参数化更新，我们推导出一个收敛界，显式地分离了评论家（critic）误差、策略回归误差和学习步长各自的贡献。为了在未知动力学下实现学习，我们将该框架与PhiBE相结合，后者能够从离散转移数据构建连续时间的代理生成器。由此得到的在策略与离策略无模型行动者-评论家（actor-critic）算法……
tldr: 该论文建立了一个从离散数据中学习的连续时间策略梯度框架，证明了熵正则化策略流向最优解的指数收敛性，并通过与PhiBE结合给出了收敛界显式分离评论家误差、策略回归误差和步长影响的无模型行动者-评论家算法。
en_tdlr: This paper develops a continuous-time policy gradient framework that learns from discrete data, proves exponential convergence of the entropy-regularized policy flow to the regularized optimum, and derives model-free on-policy and off-policy actor-critic algorithms with convergence bounds that explicitly separate critic error, policy-regression error, and learning step size via integration with PhiBE.
